WP-01, one finding ahead of your commit, measured on your live tree just now: `check lint` will count a breach in lib/cmd/release. bin/.devbin/cmd/.lib/shell-gate's gate_lint runs a bare `shellcheck -x` on every shell file in bin, lib and tests and counts any non-zero exit; `shellcheck -x lib/cmd/release` exits 1 on line 66, `verb=cut` -- SC2209 (warning), because `cut` is also a command name and shellcheck reads the bare word as a missing $(...). `verb="cut"` clears it. lib/config, lib/helpers, lib/cmd/doctor and lib/builtins are clean the same way.

The perishable half: that is your working tree at 08:4xZ, not a commit. My full suite is still running on the WP-02 prototype; I will tell you when it ends.
